headline: NFL Week 6 TNF: Broncos edge Seahawks 17-14 in overtime
whyCareReason: Wil Lutz drilled a 53-yard field goal in overtime after Ja'Quan McMillian intercepted Sam Darnold. Denver improve to 4-2 while Seattle fall to 3-3.
teaser: FINAL (OT): Broncos 17, Seahawks 14. Lutz 53-yard FG seals victory after late Seattle comeback forced overtime at Empower Field at Mile High.
story: Week 6 Thursday Night Football concluded in Denver with the Broncos defeating the Seattle Seahawks 17-14 in overtime. Denver established a 14-3 advantage in the first half with rushing touchdowns from J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey. Seattle battled back in the second half, with Jason Myers drilling a 34-yard field goal with three seconds left in regulation to tie the game 14-14. In overtime, Broncos cornerback Ja'Quan McMillian intercepted Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold, setting up Wil Lutz for a game-winning 53-yard field goal. Denver move to 4-2 in the AFC West, while Seattle drop to 3-3 in the NFC West. Minnesota and San Francisco remain 5-0, and Kansas City stand 4-0.
stakes: Denver improve to 4-2 to keep pace with the 4-0 Chiefs in the AFC West. Seattle drop to 3-3 behind the 5-0 49ers in the NFC West.
rivalryAngle: Former AFC West rivals play a defensive thriller decided on a 53-yard field goal in overtime.
funFacts: Final: Denver Broncos 17, Seattle Seahawks 14 (OT), Empower Field at Mile High.
Winning play: Wil Lutz 53-yard field goal in overtime after Ja'Quan McMillian interception.
Records: Broncos 4-2, Seahawks 3-3. Unbeaten: Vikings 5-0, 49ers 5-0, Chiefs 4-0.
